name: localize_devstral_small2_24b
command: set -o pipefail; mkdir -p logs/comparison && CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 bash repro/localize.sh mistralai/Devstral-Small-2-24B-Instruct-2512 0 24 |& tee logs/comparison/localize_devstral.log
note: 1 A100-80GB: mine the model's own pool (cache-only), then train_head_mask defaults (lam20, 50 epochs, augment) at batch 24 (64 and 32 OOM; 24 peaks at 70.0 GiB on the worst batch). On hakone it ran on GPU 2.

name: localize_glm45_air
command: set -o pipefail; mkdir -p logs/comparison && bash repro/localize.sh zai-org/GLM-4.5-Air 0,1,2,3 48 |& tee logs/comparison/localize_glm45air.log
note: 4 A100-80GB, device_map=auto: mine the model's own pool (cache-only), then train_head_mask defaults at batch 48 (64 OOMs; 48 peaks at 71.4 GiB on the fullest card). On hakone it ran on GPUs 4-7.
